podcast.body: The band's second album, "The Colour and the Shape," bears a title that Dave Grohl initially considered a "ridiculous tour anecdote" or a "stupid tour joke" with no profound meaning. However, during interviews in Japan, the band reframed the title as an example of their evolving personality, implying the album was "more colorful" and had "more personality," thus embodying "the color and the shape of the Foo Fighters" at that time. "The food fighters with Dave Grohl of course and monkey wrench from the second food is album The Color and the Shape which is a strange title. Dave? It's actually a really ridiculous tour anecdote that just a stupid tour joke means nothing at all."

"Things had not gone well during the recording sessions for the second Fuzalbum, The Color in the Shape."
